readings: For each invoice, show the invoice number, the average ratio of `derived_total_cost` to `derived_product_cost` across its line items, and how many line items it has. Give the 10 invoices with the most line items, from most to fewest.
queries:
SELECT
    i.invoice_number,
    AVG(ili.derived_total_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_product_cost, 0)) AS average_ratio,
    COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count
FROM Invoices AS i
LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
    ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
GROUP BY i.invoice_number
ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, i.invoice_number
LIMIT 10
